Definition: the multitude of Gog; the fanciful name of an emblematic place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Hamon-Gog is the name God gives to the valley where Gog's armies will be buried, the multitude of Gog laid out in the land of Israel. In Ezekiel 39:11 God says he will give Gog a place of graves there, and in Ezekiel 39:15 the travellers who find a bone set up a sign until the buriers have buried it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the valley is God's answer to every army that rises against his people: the multitude ends in graves, and the land is cleansed.
